General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This part mounts to the rear gate and its sole function is to hold the spare tire.
This is the early model that Lips Over and Attaches to the Top of the Tailgate.
Painted Black
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Spare Tire Carrier
Qty 3 – Spare Tire Cushions
Qty 3 – Screws for Cushions
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1993 Soft Top Model
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1993 Soft Top Model
NOTE: I sell two different types, an early model and late model. Check how yours mounts before ordering.
